state_ownership.purpose: Sentinel-specific signal and market-state cache only. Portfolio holdings, weights, cash balances and permanent-floor quantities are NOT stored here.
state_ownership.runtime_rule: Every Sentinel run must read portfolio-state.json directly for current BTC quantity, weights, cash, permanent-floor status and allocation inputs.

market_state_freshness.reason: The latest market scan predates the current portfolio SSOT update. Market/regime fields below are historical Sentinel state only and must be refreshed on the next Sentinel run before a new capital action.

liquidity_inflection.invalidation: Macro pressure eases and BTC reclaims the recent range without new downside confirmation
liquidity_inflection.latest_note: Historical Sentinel-specific signal state from the last market scan. Must be refreshed before any new capital action.

distribution.note: Historical Sentinel-specific distribution state. 0 validated EXTREME dimensions at the last scan. Must be refreshed before any new capital action.

allocation_gate.rule: Never use this file as a holdings/weights source. Read portfolio-state.json at runtime and recompute the allocation gate.

alerts.reason: Treasury yields and oil eased while BTC rebounded instead of extending lower; macro headwind remains but evidence is now conflicting.
